units.source_text: 阿泷正在发呆，仿佛咽下了一块硬东西。

en.t: Otaki was staring blankly, as if she had swallowed something hard.

units.source_text: 这时她慌忙站起来，走了过去，跪在男人的背后。

en.t: At that moment she hurriedly stood up, went over, and knelt behind the man.

units.source_text: 他好像是山那边银矿的矿工头。

en.t: He seemed to be the foreman of the silver mine beyond the mountain.

units.source_text: 阿泷按摩着那矿石味浓厚的壮实肩膀，手不禁颤抖起来。

en.t: As Otaki massaged those sturdy shoulders, heavy with the smell of ore, her hands began to tremble despite herself.

units.source_text: 她紧紧合拢膝头，还是觉得一股寒颤从脖颈直窜全身。

en.t: She pressed her knees tightly together, yet still felt a shudder of cold run from the nape of her neck through her whole body.

units.source_text: 她惊慌地赶忙泡到温泉里。

en.t: In a panic, she quickly sank into the hot spring.
